title: Saint Marianne Cope Day.
bodyText: January 23 of each year shall be known and designated as "Saint Marianne Cope Day", provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-8.2]  Saint Marianne Cope Day.  January 23 of each year shall be known and designated as "Saint Marianne Cope Day", provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2014, c 3, §2]
